questions.text: Consider a paging hardware with a TLB. Assume that the entire page table and all the pages are in the physical memory. It takes 10 milliseconds to search the TLB and 80 milliseconds to access the physical memory. If the TLB hit ratio is 0.6, the effective memory access time (in milliseconds) is _________.
questions.solution:
Checking each statement:
- TLB hit: 10 + 80 = 90
- TLB miss: 10 + 80 (page table) + 80 (data) = 170

EMAT = 0.6 [latex]\times[/latex] 90 + 0.4 [latex]\times[/latex] 170 = 54 + 68 = 122

Answer: 122

questions.text:
An operating system uses shortest remaining time first scheduling algorithm for pre-emptive scheduling of processes. Consider the following set of processes with their arrival times and CPU burst times (in milliseconds):

The average waiting time (in milliseconds) of the processes is _________.
questions.solution:
SRTF schedule:
- 0-2 P1 (rem 10)
- 2-6 P2 (P3 arriving at 3 needs 6, more than P2's remaining)
- 6-12 P3 (P4 arriving at 8 needs 5, more than P3's remaining 4)
- 12-17 P4, 17-27 P1

Waiting = completion [latex]-[/latex] arrival [latex]-[/latex] burst:
P1 = 27 [latex]-[/latex] 0 [latex]-[/latex] 12 = 15, P2 = 0, P3 = 12 [latex]-[/latex] 3 [latex]-[/latex] 6 = 3, P4 = 17 [latex]-[/latex] 8 [latex]-[/latex] 5 = 4

Average = 22 / 4 = 5.5

Answer: 5.5

questions.text: A system contains three programs and each requires three tape units for its operation. The minimum number of tape units which the system must have such that deadlocks never arise is _________.
questions.solution:
Worst case: each program holds 2 tapes and waits for a third. That uses 3 [latex]\times[/latex] 2 = 6 tapes with deadlock.

One more tape lets one program finish and release its tapes: 6 + 1 = 7.

Answer: 7

questions.text:
A system uses 3 page frames for storing process pages in main memory. It uses the Least Recently Used (LRU) page replacement policy. Assume that all the page frames are initially empty. What is the total number of page faults that will occur while processing the page reference string given below?
4, 7, 6, 1, 7, 6, 1, 2, 7, 2
questions.solution:
LRU with 3 frames:

- 4, 7, 6: faults (3)
- 1: fault, evict 4 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] {7, 6, 1} (4)
- 7, 6, 1: hits
- 2: fault, evict LRU 7 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] {6, 1, 2} (5)
- 7: fault, evict 6 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] {1, 2, 7} (6)
- 2: hit

Answer: 6

questions.text:
A computer has twenty physical page frames which contain pages numbered 101 through
120. Now a program accesses the pages numbered 1, 2, ..., 100 in that order, and repeats the
access sequence THRICE. Which one of the following page replacement policies experiences
the same number of page faults as the optimal page replacement policy for this program?
questions.solution:
The pages 1..100 are accessed in a cycle, and memory holds only 20.

LRU and FIFO always evict the page that will be needed soonest in a cyclic pattern, so they fault on every access. Optimal evicts the page used farthest in future, which is the most recently used page.

So MRU behaves exactly like the optimal policy here.

Answer: Most-recently-used
